camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeActiveOperationTasks --region cn-hangzhou --Status='-1' --AllowCancel='-1' --PageSize 25 --PageNumber 1 --AllowChange='-1' --TaskType rds_apsaradb_upgrade --Region 'cn-beijing' --ProductId RDS --InsName 'rm-bp191w771kd30000' --DbType all --ChangeLevel all
description_en: Queries the details about scheduled O\\\\\&M tasks for an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查看RDS实例的计划内运维任务详情
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-active-operation-tasks --biz-region cn-beijing --task-type rds_apsaradb_upgrade --page-size 25 --page-number 1 --product-id RDS --db-type all --status='-1' --ins-name rm-bp191w771kd30000 --allow-change='-1' --allow-cancel='-1' --change-level all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationTasks

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the pending event. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

The value all indicates all regions
parameters.help_zh:
待处理事件所属的地域ID，可调用DescribeRegions接口获取。
取值为all表示所有地域ID
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: primary/secondary switchover
rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration
rds_apsaradb_upgrade: update of the minor engine version
rds_apsaradb_maxscale: update of the minor version of the proxy
all: all types
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，取值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主从节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级。
rds_apsaradb_maxscale: 代理小版本升级。
all：所有任务类型
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 25. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数, 默认每页25条，最大100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The name of the service. Valid values: RDS, POLARDB, MongoDB, and Redis. For RDS instances, set the value to RDS
parameters.help_zh: 产品名称, RDS/POLARDB/MongoDB/Redis，对于RDS实例可选RDS
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the database. Default value: all. Valid values: mysql, pgsql, and mssql
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，默认为 all
可选：mysql/pgsql/mssql 等
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the task, which is used as a filter condition to return tasks.

-1: all tasks
3: pending
4: being processed
5: completed
6: failed
7: canceled
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，用于筛选返回任务。
-1：全部任务。
3：待处理任务。
4：处理中任务。
5：成功结束任务。
6：失败结束任务。
7：已取消任务
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance. You can leave this parameter empty. If you configure this parameter, you can specify the name only of one instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例名，可不填，填写时只允许填写至多一个实例名
parameters.name: ins_name

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition that is used to return tasks based on the settings of the switching time. Default value: -1. Valid values:

-1: returns all tasks.
0: returns only tasks for which the switching time cannot be changed.
1: returns only tasks for which the switching time can be changed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许修改时间，默认-1，取值：
-1：全部。
0：只返回不允许修改时间的任务。
1：只返回允许修改时间的任务
parameters.name: allow_change

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition that is used to return tasks based on the settings of task cancellation. Default value: -1. Valid values:

-1: returns all tasks.
0: returns only tasks that cannot be canceled.
1: returns only tasks that can be canceled
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许取消，默认-1，取值：

-1：全部。
0：只返回不允许取消的任务。
1：只返回允许取消的任务
parameters.name: allow_cancel

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition that is used to return tasks based on the task level. Default value: all. Valid values:

all: all types
S0: returns the tasks of the exception fixing level.
S1: returns the tasks of the system O\&M level
parameters.help_zh:
任务级别，默认为 all，取值：

all：全部
S0：返回异常修复级别的任务。
S1：返回系统运维级别的任务
parameters.name: change_level

Items.description_en: The details about the O\&M task

AllowCancel.description_en: Indicates whether the task can be canceled. The value 1 indicates that the task can be canceled. The value 0 indicates that the task cannot be canceled
AllowCancel.description_zh: 是否允许取消，1表示允许用户取消任务，0表示不允许取消

AllowChange.description_en: Indicates whether the switching time can be changed. The value 1 indicates that the switching time can be changed. The value 0 indicates that the switching time cannot be changed
AllowChange.description_zh: 是否允许修改时间，1表示允许用户修改时间，0表示不允许用户修改时间

ChangeLevel.description_en: The code of the task level. The value S1 indicates the system O\&M level. The value S0 indicates the exception fixing level
ChangeLevel.description_zh: 事件等级代码，S1 系统运维 S0 风险修复

ChangeLevelEn.description_en: The level of the task in English

ChangeLevelZh.description_en: The level of the task in Chinese

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建时间，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

DbType.description_en: The type of the database. Valid values: mysql, pgsql, and mssql

Deadline.description_en: The deadline of the switching time for the task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
Deadline.description_zh: 任务执行时间可调整范围的最晚期限，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

ImpactEn.description_en: The impact of the task in English

ImpactZh.description_en: The impact of the task in Chinese

InsComment.description_en: The alias and description of the instance

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time after the modification. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改时间，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

PrepareInterval.description_en: The required preparation period between the task start time and the switching time. The time is displayed in the HH:mm:ss format
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 开始时间到切换时间之间所需的准备时间, 格式为HH:mm:ss

Region.description_en: The region ID of the pending task
Region.description_zh: 待处理事件所属的地域ID

ResultInfo.description_en: The information about the execution result

StartTime.description_en: The time when the task was executed. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 后台执行任务的时间点，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Status.description_en:
The task status.

3: pending
4: being processed
5: completed
6: failed
7: canceled
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。
3：待处理任务。
4：处理中任务。
5：成功结束任务。
6：失败结束任务。
7：已取消任务

SwitchTime.description_en: The switching time of the task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
SwitchTime.description_zh: 后台发起切换操作的时间点，为UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

TaskType.description_en:
The type of the O\&M task. Valid values:

rds_apsaradb_ha: primary/secondary switchover
rds_apsaradb_transfer: instance migration
rds_apsaradb_upgrade: update of the minor engine version
rds_apsaradb_maxscale: minor version update of the database proxy
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型，取值：

rds_apsaradb_ha：主从节点切换。
rds_apsaradb_transfer：实例迁移。
rds_apsaradb_upgrade：小版本升级。
rds_apsaradb_maxscale: 代理小版本升级

TaskTypeEn.description_en: The reason for the task in English

TaskTypeZh.description_en: The reason for the task in Chinese

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 25
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数, 默认每页25条，最大100

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
